_comment: Levels of play for generating the world's players. talent: offsets in standard deviations of the major-league attribute distribution, in the order hitting, pitching, fielding, physical, power (on top of hitting), command (on top of pitching), velocity (on top of pitching), discipline (on top of hitting: plate discipline), velocity (on top of pitching), discipline (on top of hitting: plate discipline), fitted with `bm level` (2026-11-16) to each level's 2025-2026 official rates relative to the simulated majors, the four-seam and exit-velocity gaps where Statcast tracks them (Triple-A, Florida State League; Double-A and High-A interpolated between them, an assumption), and published translations to the majors (hitters' wRC+ against major-league pitching: Triple-A 65, Double-A 52, High-A 40, Single-A 30, KBO 56, NPB 64). The US minors were refitted (decisions 2026-11-16) with their plate discipline as well: zone %, swing % in the zone and chase % against the majors in 2026 (both on the batter-height zone), whiffs per swing in 2025-2026 (Statcast; Triple-A and the Florida State League, Double-A and High-A interpolated), and with no level above the level over it in hitting, pitching, fielding, command or discipline (measured from the majors). physical is fixed at the Triple-A fit (-0.215) wherever no tracking pins it (decision 2026-11-16). The KBO Futures and NPB farm hitters sit the Triple-A to Double-A gap below their first teams (assumption). The rookie complex and the Dominican academy have no statistics: their talent is the career model's steady state. ball_drag: factor on the batted ball's drag in the level's own games; the lower minors play with a ball of their own (fitted on Single-A, which has Statcast). batters/pitchers: ages on 1 February 2027; the means are Baseball-Reference league averages for 2025-2026 (docs/research/world/levels.md section 4: whole years on 30 June, close to exact ages on 1 February). The US levels' spreads are the MLB Stats API's 2025-2026 lines with Baseball-Reference's weights (section 4.1); the limits of Double-A, High-A and Single-A are the 99th percentiles of those ages, moved to 1 February (decision 2026-11-16: older players who are not prospects do not stay below Triple-A). The rookie complex (Arizona and Florida Complex Leagues) and the Dominican academy (Dominican Summer League) take their means and spreads from the same source, with the oldest 2 % of playing time (major-leaguers' rehabilitation assignments) left out. The other limits, the KBO's, the NPB's and the KBO Futures' spreads are assumptions. roster: players per club (2026 rules). foreign: the foreign players a KBO or NPB club fields: hitters at wRC+ 88 against major-league pitching (Davenport 2016: EqA .247 against .260), pitchers symmetric (major-leaguers' wRC+ 112 against them; decision 2026-11-16). Edit freely.
